extracted.intended_audience: investigative journalists or news organizations submitting entries to the IRE Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Checklist and eligibility rules for submitting entries to the Investigative Reporters and Editors (IRE) Awards across multiple categories (print/online, video, audio, student, book, special categories and named awards). It specifies required materials, format limits, hosting and upload instructions, ad-removal rules, fees, and category-specific eligibility constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contest questionnaire required
rubrics_metrics.description: All entries must submit the required contest questionnaire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer the contest questionnaire and save it as a PDF; follow the FAQ for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online medium eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for the Print/Online category, your story must be primarily in print or online text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any audio or video elements will be considered only as supplementary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — IRE membership requirement (through July 2023)
rubrics_metrics.description: I am a current IRE member (or entering on behalf of one) through July 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — limit of primary stories/elements
rubrics_metrics.description: I have no more than five primary stories/elements selected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You are limited to five primary stories/elements in your entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — include links and text version
rubrics_metrics.description: I have included links (with login & password info) AND a text version of my primary story(ies) in one document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An example is provided; include any login/password information needed for judges to access links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — remove ads and sponsorships from PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have removed all ads, house ads and sponsorship from the pdf of my entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove advertising material so the PDF contains only editorial content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — PDF size limit
rubrics_metrics.description: I have saved my primary entry materials as a PDF that is no larger than 25 MB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — cover letter optional
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand I can include a cover letter to the judges as supplemental material, but I am not required to do so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Print/Online — other supplemental material optional
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand that I can provide other supplemental material but am not required to do so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video medium eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for the Video category, your story must be primarily presented in video.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any text or audio elements will be considered supplementary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — IRE membership requirement (through July 2023)
rubrics_metrics.description: I am a current IRE member (or entering on behalf of one) through July 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — contest questionnaire saved as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have answered the contest questionnaire and saved it as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — condensed video length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: I have no more than one hour (condensed) video of primary stories/elements selected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a condensed compilation no longer than one hour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — remove commercials/sponsors/house ads
rubrics_metrics.description: I have removed all commercials, including sponsors, underwriting and house ads, from my video.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes bumps and teasers that are not original editorial content or show opens that mention funders or advertising. Any ads left in will result in disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — host condensed video on third-party site
rubrics_metrics.description: I have uploaded my condensed video of primary stories/elements to a third-party video hosting site (e.g. YouTube or Vimeo).

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — provide link and login info in text document
rubrics_metrics.description: I put the link to my primary story/stories (hosted on a third-party video hosting site) in a text document and included any login/password information for the judges, if needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An example is provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — save primary entry materials as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have saved my primary entry materials file as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — save transcript as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have saved the transcript of my primary entry materials as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — cover letter optional
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand I can include a cover letter to the judges as supplemental material, but I am not required to do so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio medium eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for the Audio category, your story must be primarily presented in audio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any text or video elements will be considered only as supplementary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — IRE membership requirement (through July 2023)
rubrics_metrics.description: I am a current IRE member (or entering on behalf of one) through July 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — contest questionnaire saved as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have answered the contest questionnaire and saved it as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — condensed audio length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: I have no more than one hour (condensed) audio of primary stories/elements selected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a condensed compilation no longer than one hour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — remove commercials/sponsors/house ads
rubrics_metrics.description: I have removed all commercials, including sponsors, underwriting and house ads, from my audio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes preroll, midroll and post roll and anything that is not editorial content or show opens that mention funders or advertising. Any ads left in will result in disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — host condensed audio on third-party site
rubrics_metrics.description: I have uploaded my condensed audio of primary stories/elements to a third-party audio hosting site (e.g. SoundCloud).

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — provide link and login info in text document
rubrics_metrics.description: I put the link to my primary story/stories (hosted on a third-party audio hosting site) in a text document and included any login/password information for the judges, if needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An example is provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — save primary entry materials as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have saved my primary entry materials file as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — save transcript as PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: I have saved the transcript of my primary entry materials as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio — cover letter optional
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand I can include a cover letter to the judges, but I am not required to do so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student category eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible for the Student category, work must have been done by a student or group of students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow platform-specific rules for entering and fill out the contest questionnaire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books category — scope and fee
rubrics_metrics.description: For outstanding investigative reporting that resulted in a published book. The cost to enter is $75.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only eBooks will be accepted for submission; you may include a link or a PDF through the online submission process. Please fill out the questionnaire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special categories — medium and fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Special Categories: Any medium, any size circulation or market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow guidelines above for entering based on your platform and fill out the questionnaire. The cost to enter any of the special categories is $75.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tom Renner Award — subject and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Award for the best investigative reporting (single story or lifetime body of work) covering organized crime or other criminal acts; comes with a medal and $500.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to platform-specific rules above for required entry material. The cost to enter is $75. Limited to 10 stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: IRE FOI Award — purpose and fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors an individual or organization whose significant actions further open records or open government; comes with an IRE Medal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to platform-specific rules above for required entry material. The cost to enter is $75.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigations Triggered by Breaking News — timeliness requirement and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: For outstanding investigative work done within 30 days of a news event or development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award honors deep and quick digging using investigative techniques to produce exclusive and timely information. Refer to platform-specific rules above for required entry material. The cost to enter is $75. Limit to 5 stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: IRE Award for Sports Investigations — subject and fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors investigations that dig into the darker side of sports from amateur leagues to professional organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to platform-specific rules above for required entry material. The cost to enter is $75.
